name: Stonetalon Sap
summary: Near Mirkfallon Lake and Stonetalon Peak, sap beasts carry the sap Jin'Zil seeks. The Darkspear witch doctor uses it in a brew for his caged night elf prisoners.

sections.title: A Bitter Harvest
sections.body: Sap beasts near Mirkfallon Lake and Stonetalon Peak carry a potent woodland fluid. Jin'Zil of Malaka'jin seeks the sap for a brew he calls forest magic. He intends it for his caged night elf prisoners, turning the essence of their cherished wilderness against them.

aliases: where do you get stonetalon sap
faq.answer: Sap beasts near Mirkfallon Lake and on the slopes toward Stonetalon Peak carry Stonetalon Sap.

faq.q: What does Witch Doctor Jin'Zil use the sap for?
faq.answer: Jin'Zil combines the sap with courser eyes, twilight whiskers, and a fey dragon scale to make a toxic brew for his caged night elf prisoners.

faq.q: Where is the best place to find sap beasts?
faq.answer: Sap beasts live in the groves around Mirkfallon Lake and along the paths toward Stonetalon Peak.

faq.q: Is the sap magical on its own?
faq.answer: The sap carries the vitality of the Stonetalon highlands, but Jin'Zil needs troll mojo and specific reagents to make it lethal.

angles.text: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil shows how the Darkspear can turn an enemy's beloved surroundings into a weapon of voodoo.
A Horde witch doctor poisons caged night elf prisoners with Stonetalon's native elements, an outrage against nature and Elune.
